proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q hab
  have hN : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    by_cases ha₀ : a = 0
    · have hb₀ : b ≠ 0 := fun hb₀ => hab ⟨ha₀, hb₀⟩
      positivity
    · positivity
  refine ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · field_simp; ring
  · intro x y hl
    congr 1
    have hw : a * (x - p) + b * (y - q) = -(a * p + b * q + c) := by linear_combination hl
    have : (x - (p - 2 * a * (a * p + b * q + c) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2))) ^ 2 + (y - (q - 2 * b * (a * p + b * q + c) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2))) ^ 2 - ((x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2) = 4 * (a * p + b * q + c) * (a * (x - p) + b * (y - q) + (a * p + b * q + c)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [hw] at this
    simp only [neg_add_cancel, mul_zero, zero_div] at this
    linarith
